core_meaning.short_meaning: Kunya of the companion Abu Dharr al-Ghifari
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abu Dharr (أبو ذر) is the kunya by which the companion Jundub ibn Junada al-Ghifari is best known. He was an early convert renowned for asceticism and for his frank speech. The form is a kunya (“father of Dharr”) rather than a birth name, and the element Dharr is a proper name.
